runtimeScope: P2 is third-party LGPLv3-path proof infrastructure because the reviewed build uses --enable-version3. It is not a selected shipping runtime, public-distribution approval, or approval to use every component compiled into the archive.
componentSelectionPolicy: Every command must explicitly select or record every concrete demuxer, decoder, encoder, muxer, filter, and stream selector used. Presence is not semantic proof.
deliveryPolicy: WebM VP9/Opus is an open-delivery proof candidate only, not the final ReelForge default.
